text:
4.3.1.8.2 Data Element Invalidation in case of Intra-ECU communication
Sender:
[SWS_Rte_05025]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00078
⌈If data element invalidation is enabled, and the communication is Intra-ECU,
data element invalidation shall be implemented by the RTE.⌋
The actual invalid value is specified in the SW-C template invalidValue.
Receiver:
[SWS_Rte_05030]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00078
⌈If a data element has been invalidated in case of Intra-ECU communication and the
attribute handleInvalid is set to keep – the query of the value shall return the same
value as if COM would have handled the invalidation (copy COM behavior). Then the
reception of the invalid value will be handled as an error and the activation of runnable
entities can be performed using the DataReceiveErrorEvent.⌋
[SWS_Rte_05049]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00078
⌈If a data element has been received invalidated in case of Intra-ECU communica-
tion and the attribute handleInvalid is set to replace – RTE shall perform the
"invalid value substitution" with the initValue. Then the reception will be handled
as if a valid value would have been received (activation of runnable entities using the
DataReceivedEvent).⌋
[SWS_Rte_08050]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00078
⌈If a data element has been received invalidated in case of Intra-ECU communication
and the attribute handleInvalid is set to dontInvalidate – the query of the value
shall return the received value. Then the reception will be handled as if a valid value
would have been received (activation of runnable entities using the DataReceivedE-
vent).⌋
[SWS_Rte_02308] ⌈If data invalidation is enabled for a composite VariableDat-
aPrototype, and the communication is Intra-ECU, the RTE shall invalidate all invali-
dateable primitive elements of the VariableDataPrototype.⌋
[SWS_Rte_02309]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00078
⌈The RTE generator shall reject configurations which are violating [constr_1302].⌋
